## File Isolated Card (FI)

The full work surface for a file.

### Composition

The hero is the family's own renderer **at the source's aspect ratio** — not a fixed frame the image is fitted into. Beside it sits a property area that groups three distinct kinds of knowledge, and keeping them visibly distinct is the design:

| Group | What it is |
|---|---|
| what the realm knows | name, size, type, when it arrived |
| what the parser extracted | the family's metadata field |
| what was computed from that | derived and computed values |

A reader who cannot tell an extracted fact from a computed one cannot tell which number to distrust when the file changes.

### Every displayed fact is a real field

The rule that keeps this view honest: nothing is rendered here that is not a declared field on the card.

That means the **default editor stays the correction surface** — if a value is wrong, you fix it where every other value is fixed. This view never becomes the only place a value exists, which is what happens when an isolated template starts computing its own display-only facts inline.

### Empty schema is a real answer

A GTS module may export utilities only. The shell says so plainly (*"schema detected — this module may export utilities or components"*) rather than rendering an empty property panel that reads as a failure.

### The family this belongs to

Five pieces make up how a file renders in Boxel:

| Piece | Job |
|---|---|
| `file-shell-atom` | inline reference — icon, name, extension |
| `file-shell-embedded` | complete content, flowing inside a document |
| `file-shell-fitted` | the parent-sized collection cell |
| `file-shell-isolated` | the full work surface |
| `file-preview-stage` | the slot all four project into; owns loading, failure, provenance |

A shell never knows how to draw a PDF, a waveform or a 3D scene. It renders the
stage, and the stage hands the remaining space to the family's own renderer,
declared by a FileDef subclass as `static previewComponent`. A file whose family
has no renderer yet gets an honest generic pane rather than a broken one.
